name: Hammam Simulator
detailed_description:
💦 Step into the Steam, Embrace the Tradition!

Hammam Simulator lets you experience the authentic rituals of a traditional bathhouse. Scrub, foam, and cleanse as you manage the daily operations of a bustling hammam. Feel the warmth of marble, hear the soothing sound of water, and immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and tradition.

🛁 Key Features:
🧼 Authentic Hammam Experience – Perform classic bathing rituals like scrubbing, foaming, and massaging.
🚿 Interactive Gameplay – Clean and serve customers in a realistic first-person experience.
🏛️ Beautifully Designed Environments – Explore intricately detailed bathhouses inspired by historical architecture.
👤 Customer Management – Keep your visitors satisfied and maintain the reputation of your hammam.
🌡️ Steam-Powered Realism – Feel the heat, see the steam, and enjoy the calming ambiance.

Prepare your towels, heat the stones, and let the cleansing begin! ♨️🌿

content_descriptors.notes:
Hammam Simulator does not include any sexual acts, graphic violence, or abusive content. The only mature element is the presence of stylized bathhouse customers wearing towels or traditional coverings—there is no full nudity or sexualized visuals. The game focuses on hygiene and cleaning in a respectful and non-explicit way.

There are no depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual acts, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm in the game.
